met_analysis:
The Low-Pressure Area over northeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood with associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 4.5 km above mean sea level persisted over the same region at 1730 Hrs IST of today, the 28th August 2026. It is very likely to become less marked during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jammu, Dehradun, Kheri, centre of Low Pressure Area over northeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood, Dehri, Bankura, Kolkata and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal and extends upto 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Bay of Bengal & adjoining West Bengal-Bangladesh coasts lies over Northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining West Bengal-Bangladesh coasts extending upto 7.6 km above mean sea level titling southwestwards with height. Under its influence, a low pressure area is likely to form over northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining West Bengal-north Odisha coasts around 29th August, 2026.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level have merged with monsoon trough.
The Western Disturbance now seen as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & adjoining north Punjab at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
